hints.content:
For the $x$ pattern, we add $10$ more to each row.

For the $y$ pattern, we add $3$ more to each row.

Pattern $x$: Add $\goldE{10}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{15}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{15} + \goldE{10}=\maroonE{25}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{25} + \goldE{10}=\purpleD{35}\end{align}$

Pattern $y$: Add $\tealE{3}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{12}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{12} + \tealE{3}=\maroonE{15}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{15} + \tealE{3}=\purpleD{18}\end{align}$

Our table of values should look like this:

$x$ | $y$ 
- | - | -
$15$ | $12$ 
$25$ | $15$ 
$35$ | $18$
